As a Shunter in Hedel, you make sure trucks and trailers are in the right place at the right time. Depending on your experience, you earn up to € 20.24 gross per hour. About the job 
As a Shunter, you make sure the transport process at the Hedel location runs smoothly. You move trucks and trailers between different locations and make sure the right equipment is ready on time for the next trip or for loading and unloading. During your shift, you'll be busy coupling and uncoupling trailers and moving equipment around the yard or between depots. Before you leave, you check the vehicle and the load to ensure everything is moved safely and efficiently. You work closely with planners, warehouse staff, and drivers. Together, you make sure transport keeps moving and everything is in the right place on time. Your tasks include: - Shuttling trucks and trailers between locations; - Coupling and uncoupling trailers; - Moving trailers and other equipment on the yard and between depots; - Checking vehicles and loads before departure; - Making sure equipment is in the right place on time; - Following safety rules on site; - Working closely with planners, warehouse staff, and drivers; - Ensuring safe and efficient transport flow. 
You work fixed shifts from Sunday to Thursday, 3:00 PM to midnight, so you always have Fridays and Saturdays off. For hours worked on Sunday, you receive a 200% bonus.

jobs.description:
International, centrally positioned role with direct impact on the deployment of thousands of tank containers worldwide.
You have a good job. But you feel there’s more in it for you.
Maybe you’re looking for greater international impact. Or you’re ready to move beyond environments where data lags behind reality.
At our client, that’s exactly the challenge.
Today, the global fleet is still largely managed through manual spreadsheets. Data is fragmented, often outdated, and not available in real time.
You are going to fundamentally change that.
For one of the world’s largest tank container leasing companies — managing over 75,000 tank containers globally — we are looking for a Data Analyst for an internationally focused, centrally positioned role based in Rotterdam.
In this role, you don’t just report on numbers — you directly influence the deployment, availability, and planning of tank containers worldwide. Your work ensures that stakeholders across the globe can generate accurate, real-time reports at any moment and use them for decision-making.
This level of tangible impact is rare in a data analyst role.
About the organization
Our client is one of the largest tank container leasing companies in the world. With a global fleet and international customer base, data plays an increasingly critical role in its success.
The organization is undergoing a transition from manual, Excel-driven processes to data-driven operations with real-time insights.
As part of the Marmon Group (a Berkshire Hathaway company), you benefit from a strong international foundation combined with the dynamics of an evolving organization.
The culture is open, international, and results-driven, offering significant responsibility and room for initiative.
Your challenge
As a Data Analyst, you operate at the heart of an international operation. You ensure a single source of truth and support the Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (SIOP) process.
You work with data from multiple systems — inclu.

Your profile
This role suits you if you look beyond numbers and want to make a real impact in an international supply chain environment.
Bachelor’s degree (e.g. in Data, Supply Chain, or Business Administration)
Minimum 5 years of experience as a Data Analyst within a logistics, manufacturing, or supply chain environment
Strong skills in Excel, Power BI (including DAX), and SQL
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify patterns quickly
Confident and effective in working with international stakeholders
Proactive, with the ability to provide both solicited and unsolicited advice
International experience is essential. You have worked in a global supply chain environment (e.g. logistics, leasing, shipping, or manufacturing) and have proven experience with SIOP processes.
You are not a pure IT specialist, but a business-oriented data analyst who understands how processes work and how data drives decision-making.
Additionally:
Fluent in English (Dutch is a plus)
Available for a full-time role (40 hours)
Comfortable working across multiple time zones
Technical qualifications
In this role, you operate at the intersection of data and supply chain. Therefore, experience with the following is important:
Approximately 4–7 years of experience in data or business analytics within supply chain or SIOP
SQL, data modeling (star/snowflake), Power BI (DAX), and Excel (Power Query / Power Pivot)
Data quality frameworks and master data management
Demand planning, inventory management, and SIOP processes
Connecting operational and financial data
Collaboration with Finance on reporting and forecasting
Working with international stakeholders across multiple time zones
Preferred D365 F&O · Azure / Synapse / Databricks / Data Lake · SAP IBP, Kinaxis, or Anaplan · Python or R · Power Automate · external data sources (market data, POS, distribution data)
